dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: Oh, I'm just getting ready to buy some fish.

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: After visiting Uncle Gao's stand, I can't help but feel that Uncle Sun's fish are not only cheaper, but more fresh too!

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: I think it's the perfect chance to buy a load of fish to make for my husband. I'm just worried I wouldn't be able to move such a load. If only "The Wrench" were here...

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: Yes, haven't you heard of Wrench Wang down in the shipyard? He's known for his great strength. Why, he'd help haul this load and carry me back home on his shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: He's been good to me as long as I can remember. He would always share any tasty food he had, and he even taught me arithmetic. He's like a brother to me!

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: But he doesn't seem very fond of my husband for some odd reason. He's always staring at him.

dialogues.speaker: Siyu
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only there were some way to help them get along...
